blocks.title: Pehli ionization energy
blocks.text: Gaisi halat mein unsur ke atoms ke ek mole mein har atom se ek electron nikal kar gaisi 1+ ions ka ek mole banane ke liye darkar tawanai pehli ionization energy (delta H i1) hai.

Sodium ke liye, Na(g) se Na+(g) + e-, delta H i1 = 494 kJ fi mol; calcium ke liye, Ca(g) se Ca+(g) + e-, delta H i1 = 590 kJ fi mol. Agar gaisi 1+ ions ke ek mole mein har ion se doosra electron nikala jaye to woh doosri ionization energy hai: Ca+(g) se Ca2+(g) + e-, delta H i2 = 1150 kJ fi mol. Har 2+ ion se teesra electron nikalna teesri ionization energy hai: Ca2+(g) se Ca3+(g) + e-, delta H i3 = 4940 kJ fi mol. Kisi unsur ki utni ionization energies ho sakti hain jitna us ka atomic number.
Ionization energy par asar dalne wale awamil

items: Nuclear charge: moassar nuclear charge jitna zyada, electrostatic kashish utni zyada aur electron nikalna utna mushkil, to ionization energy moassar nuclear charge ke saath barhti hai.
Atom ya ion ki jasamat: bare atoms mein nucleus aur bairooni electrons ke darmiyan kashish kamzor hai, to jasamat barhne par ionization energy ghat'ti hai, aur is ke bar-aks.

Electronic tarteeb: aadhe bhare aur poore bhare orbitals zyada mustahkam hain, to jab electron poore ya aadhe bhare shell se nikalna ho to ionization energy zyada hoti hai. Noble gases apne mustahkam ns2 np6 shells ki wajah se apne periods mein sab se zyada ionization energy rakhti hain. Oxygen ki ionization energy nitrogen se kam hai: nitrogen 1s2 2s2 2px1 2py1 2pz1 (1403 kJ fi mol) aur oxygen 1s2 2s2 2px2 2py1 2pz1 (1365 kJ fi mol) hai; agarche nitrogen mein ek unit kam nuclear charge hai, us ke aadhe bhare subshell ki izafi istehkam us ka electron nikalna mushkil banata hai.
Shielding effect: shielding jitni zyada, valence electrons nikalna utna asaan. Andarooni electrons jitne zyada, screening utni zyada aur ionization energy utni kam.

Spin-pair repulsion: jab do electrons ek hi orbital mein spin-paired hon to un ki repulsion ek ko nikalna ghair-jora electron ke muqable zara asaan banati hai. Oxygen ke ek 2p orbital mein do spin-paired electrons hain, to us ki ionization energy nisbatan kam hai; nitrogen ke teen 2p electrons ghair-jora hain, to ek nikalne mein zyada tawanai lagti hai.

blocks.text: Group mein neeche jate hue nuclear charge barhta hai, magar atom ki jasamat aur shielding karne wale electrons ki tadaad bhi barhti hai, to ionization energy oopar se neeche ghat'ti hai. Group 1 mein tarteeb Li zyada Na zyada K zyada Rb zyada Cs hai; cesium ka 6s valence electron nucleus se door aur rubidium ke 5s electron se asaan nikalta hai. Period mein baen se daen shells ki tadaad wohi rehti hai jab ke moassar nuclear charge barhta hai, to electron nikalna mushkil hota jata hai; ek hi shell mein shielding ek jaisi hai aur gini nahin jati, to ionization energy barhti hai. Periods 1 se 3 ka rujhan noble gases ko sab se zyada qeemat ke saath dikhata hai, kyunke un ke mukammal bairooni shells electron nikalna nihayat mushkil banate hain, aur alkali metals ko sab se kam.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen se argon tak anasir ke muqable pehli ionization energy ka line graph: helium, neon aur argon par chotiyan, lithium aur sodium par gehraiyan, aur boron, oxygen, aluminium aur sulfur par chhote dips. Neeche notes period mein rujhan, group mein, do dips, aur calcium ki yake baad deegare ionization energies samjhate hain.
blocks.caption: Periods 1 se 3 mein pehli ionization energy ke rujhan ki shakal (Figure 1.6 ke mutabiq asal diagram; oonchaiyan sirf rujhan ki hain, likhi qeematein kitab ki).
blocks.long_description: Ionization energy har period mein noble gas ki choti tak charhti aur agle alkali metal ki gehrai tak girti hai. Period ke andar do dips hain: beryllium aur magnesium ke baad, jab agla electron oonche p subshell mein jata hai, aur nitrogen aur phosphorus ke baad, jab agla electron jora banata hai aur spin-pair repulsion use nikalna asaan karti hai, isi liye oxygen (1365 kJ fi mol) nitrogen (1403) se neeche hai. Group mein neeche qeematein girti hain jaise atoms barhte aur shielding barhti hai. Ek unsur ki yake baad deegare ionization energies barhti hain, jaise calcium ki 590, 1150 aur 4940 kJ fi mol dikhati hain.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke boron ki pehli ionization energy beryllium se kam kyun hai, aur aluminium ki magnesium se kam kyun.
blocks.explanation: Beryllium ke bairooni electrons 2s subshell bharte hain, ek mustahkam poora subshell, jab ke boron ka izafi electron oonchi tawanai ke 2p subshell mein akela, zyada bahar aur behtar shield hai, to asani se nikalta hai. Aluminium aur magnesium ek period neeche yehi pattern dohrate hain: magnesium ka 3s poora hai, aur aluminium ka akela 3p electron asani se nikalta hai.

items: Pehli ionization energy: gaisi atoms ke ek mole mein har atom se ek electron nikalne ki tawanai (Na 494, Ca 590 kJ fi mol); doosri aur teesri bari hain (Ca 1150, 4940).

Nuclear charge aur poore ya aadhe bhare subshells se barhti; bari jasamat, zyada shielding aur spin-pair repulsion se ghat'ti hai. Group mein neeche girti (Li zyada Na zyada K zyada Rb zyada Cs), period mein noble gas tak barhti hai.
